notes: Authorization ordering verified against the parent probes: pre-IO path is start_cost -> remaining() -> [inside scheduled task] store.assert_current -> checked('before_io') -> local_remaining (clock only) -> transport.generate; accept path is settle_cost -> remaining() -> validate_output -> Provenance -> store.assert_current -> checked('before_accept') -> cancellation -> local_remaining -> return. No blocking store call follows the final checkpoint at either boundary, and test_no_blocking_lease_read_after_final_authorization would fail on either regression (armed read sets revoked; transport asserts; final assert).

Cost primitives: reserve_cost/start_cost run under _attempt (BEGIN EXCLUSIVE, clock sampled after lock, final _fresh_attempt) with a same-day wrapper on the last sample; job cap, namespace UTC-day cap, cumulative call count (<=3, non-released rows), overrun stop, profile first-use pin (Conflict on drift), call-id tombstone, fence/owner-bound single 'reserved'->'started' transition, settle idempotent/contradiction Conflict, unknown retains maximum, release only from 'reserved'. Fixture arithmetic checked: 1789257600 == 2026-09-13T00:00:00Z and APPLICATION_ID 0x42524653 == 1112688211; migration test compares DDL/rows before/after and refuses user_version=3 / foreign app id without byte changes.

Conservative-but-lossy path (not a blocker): when start_cost is denied (BudgetDenied on day change/lower daily cap, LeaseLost, or the reserve-then-cancel Conflict branch) generate returns without releasing the provably unstarted reservation and without reservation_id in the result; the row stays 'reserved', charging job cap and one call slot until A04 reconciles via cost_record(scope, job_id, call_id)/release_cost. Document this A04 duty.

generate's timeout branch in _bounded_call sets the caller-supplied cancellation Event as a cooperative stop signal; A04 must not read that event as an operator cancellation (result status is 'timeout').

Non-Conflict store failures after IO (StoreBusy/ClockError from settle_cost, mark_cost_unknown, assert_current; ClockError inside local_remaining at accept) propagate as exceptions rather than a GenerationResult; spend remains started/settled (safe), but A04 must treat any exception as unknown outcome. ClockError raised inside prepare() is labeled 'transport_error'.

settle_cost/mark_cost_unknown/release_cost validate the WorkerContext format only and do not bind it to the reservation's owner/fence; acceptable per the trusted-internal-capability docstring but A04 must not expose these to endpoint input.

_LINK is an escape-form filter with residual edges: false positives on '<name>' placeholders, '[ref]:' reference syntax, 'socket.io', 'node.js/x', 'Data:5'; false negatives on bare unlisted TLDs (e.g. 'evil.xyz' without slash). Acceptable given the mandatory plain-text/no-autolink rendering contract; it is not semantic verification, as documented.

All SQLite calls (including store.assert_current inside the scheduled prepare()) block the event loop, so asyncio.wait's timeout cannot preempt a slow DB wait; the subsequent local_remaining/remaining checks still reject expired deadlines. A04 should run generate off the loop or accept loop stalls.

test_duplicate_logical_call_has_at_most_one_provider_call relies on deterministic task scheduling rather than a true race; the actual guarantee is the exclusive-lock single 'reserved'->'started' transition in start_cost, which the concurrent reservation test and lock-wait clock test exercise. Cancellation test correctly distinguishes requested cancellation from proven termination.
A fully empty output (all sections empty) is rejected as invalid_output rather than needs_input; consistent with 'no usable claims' but worth noting for A04 retry policy.
